search.queryText:
_index=sumologic_volume sizeInBytes
| where _sourceCategory="sourcehost_volume"
| parse regex "\"(?<sourcehost>[^\"]+)\"\:\{\"sizeInBytes\"\:(?<bytes>\d+),\"count\"\:(?<count>\d+)\}" multi
| timeslice 1h
| bytes/1024/1024/1024 as gbytes
| sum(gbytes) as gbytes by sourcehost, _timeslice
| transpose row _timeslice column sourcehost
